articles.summary: Omeros Corporation (Nasdaq: OMER) today announced that the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) of the European Medicines Agency (EMA) issued a negative opinion on the company’s marketing authorization application (MAA) for narsoplimab for the treatment of hematopoietic stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (TA-TMA) following re-examination of its original negative opinion adopted in June 2026. An eight-member ad hoc expert group (AHEG) consisting of hematologists, statisticians, and transplant physicians, together with two patient representatives, was convened by CHMP as part of the re-examination process. The AHEG was charged with addressing a single, three-part question prepared and posed by CHMP. articles.title: Omeros Corporation Receives CHMP Negative Opinion Following Re-Examination of European Marketing Authorization Application for Narsoplimab in TA-TMA
